review.description: Compared glossary terms.json with main: all canonical meanings, aliases, IDs and scopes remain byte-for-byte unchanged. Streaming SHA-256 consumes the same verification bytes and introduces no product vocabulary.
review.implementation: Reviewed artifact_digest and helper_identity: only whole-file allocation changes to hashlib.file_digest, preserving descriptor binding, inode metadata, symlink records, watches and per-traversal alias deduplication. No glossary consumer or dependency direction changes.
review.tests: Inspected the new empty/multi-buffer digest assertions plus existing restored-write, alias, FIFO, signal and descriptor-close controls. Product fixture suites remain required, and no real-host gap is claimed closed.
